title: ComfyUI-DreamScene360 — Panoramic Gaussian Splatting and 3D Scenes
summary: A specialized ComfyUI node suite that implements the DreamScene360 research for generating globally consistent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes from single 360° panoramic images. It utilizes depth estimation and panoramic splatting to create explorable 3D environments from a single viewpoint.
research_notes: Requires full CUDA Toolkit and C++ compilation during installation; 16GB+ VRAM (RTX 3090/4090) is strongly recommended for stable performance.

evolution.summary: Originally based on the ECCV 2024 paper, this ComfyUI implementation evolved in late 2025 to include improved depth stitching for panorama chunks and seamless integration with the ComfyUI-3D-Viewer-Pro suite. As of mid-2026, it remains actively maintained for the latest 3DGS rasterizers.
